offering_description.value: Bridger Aerospace provides aerial firefighting and wildfire surveillance to government agencies. It operates water-scooping aircraft for fire suppression and uses surveillance aircraft to map fires and coordinate the aerial response. It also designs and installs aircraft modifications and integrates mission equipment for commercial and government customers.

primary_services.value: aerial wildfire suppression; aerial fire surveillance and mapping; airborne firefighting coordination; aircraft modification and systems integration

customer_segment.value: B2G: U.S. Forest Service, state wildfire agencies and government aviation programs; B2B: commercial aircraft operators and aerospace contractors

end_markets.value: wildfire management; commercial aviation; military and government aviation

revenue_model.value: project or contract: aircraft standby and flight hours under wildfire response contracts, plus aircraft modification and integration projects

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: operates water-scooping and surveillance aircraft for wildfire agencies; service provider: engineers and installs mission systems on aircraft for commercial and government customers

geography_served.value: US national: serves federal and state agencies across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: aerial fire suppression, wildfire surveillance and coordination, and aircraft modification and integration

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: government procurement contracts and direct contracts with commercial aerospace customers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FAA requirements for aircraft operations, airworthiness and approval of aircraft modifications

notes: The current extent of operations outside the United States is uncertain.
